aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets stretch growth, aiming for ~4%/month. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware this strategy amplifies both upside and drawdown, and leveraged ETFs experience daily decay. Strict stop discipline is crucial to manage substantial potential losses.
